title: christmas projector
text: christmas projector. This is pretty cool.  Not just for christmas as it has slides for most other major holidays.  My other projectors are white snow flakes so this one we put in the center (we have 3 large front windows).  It's bright and clear if closer to the display area.  If you want to cover a large area like a garage or full side or front of house, you will need multiple projectors because the further you get away from the display area, the less defined, sort of foggy looking the projected pictures are.  I found this projector was just fine for our uses.  It worked throughout the month we used it. I am not sure if we will take out for other holidays, but the option is there.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
